text:
maya: heads up — canary for q4f-raven-2026 showing a small but consistent spike in function-call parse failures (about 2% of requests). observed right after we enabled the structured-output wrangler in the postprocess chain.

simon: can you paste a failing example + any parser logs?

maya: yep. failing parser log: 
```
parse_error: JSONDecodeError at pos 0: Expecting value
  raw: 'WRA: {"command": "create_ticket", "args": {"title": "..."},'
```
model output excerpt (raw streaming chunks):
```
{"command": "create_ticket", "args": {"title": "User report: can't login", "body": "stack trace..."},

}
```
looks like wrangler is prefixing with `WRA:` in some cases and chunk boundaries leave an extra newline/commas. parser sees 'WRA:' and fails.

li: hmm. we built wrangler to add a short hint header for debugging — but it should be stripped before parse. streaming mode probably concatenates frames and we accidentally kept the header on a non-first frame.

arjun: is this only with streaming=true? canary config shows stream enabled for low latency.

maya: correct — repro only when stream=true + wrangler=true. if stream=false error rate drops to ~0.1%.

ops-bot: deploy "wrangler/0.13.2" to canary finished 2112223300 :white_check_mark:

simon: this explains it. two quick mitigations: 1) in postprocess, strip any leading non-JSON tokens before parse (regex), 2) reassemble streaming frames fully before handing to wrangler. both are quick; which do you prefer?

li: do both but short term do (1). regex: `^.*?(\{[\s\S]*)$` to capture from first `{`. safe for most outputs. add a guard that ensures captured string length > 10.

maya: implemented (1) in canary, rolled to 10% traffic. early numbers: parse failures dropped from 2% -> 0.4% but saw slight tail latency +18ms p95.

arjun: latency tradeoff expected since we now wait to reassemble at least one frame boundary. long-term we should fix wrangler to not inject headers mid-stream. open a quick PR to remove the `WRA:` prefix unless debug=true.

maya: opened PR #4123. also added failing prompt samples to the structured-output eval harness so this won't regress.

simon: also add a telemetry tag `wrangler.prefix_seen` and capture sample raw frames for any parse failure for 7 days. will help root-cause.

li: follow-up test: toggle streaming frame size to 2k and see if boundary frequency changes. if we push more tokens per frame we should see fewer mid-json splits.

maya: good idea — running that now in a micro-canary and will report numbers tomorrow.

arjun: plan: short-term fix deployed, add telemetry, add failing samples to evals, PR to remove prefix. medium-term: rework streaming reassembly in wrangler and add unit tests.

maya: thanks team. will keep monitoring. :thumbsup:
